summary.text: Jenna Arsenault is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 112, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Joe Bustos (R) is also on the ballot.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a social worker, registered nurse and postpartum doula.

paragraphs.text: Arsenault earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine in 2002, a graduate degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2004, and an associate degree from Trident Technical College in 2011, and her listed career experience is in healthcare.
She advanced from the Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot after the June 9, 2026 primary was canceled.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Arsenault said her work in healthcare, social services and maternal health gives her a perspective she considers lacking in Columbia.

She named affordability as a campaign message, citing housing costs and the pressure of living paycheck to paycheck, and said she supports affordable housing solutions, local employment opportunities and balanced taxes with shared responsibility.
